description:
A sudden car accident claims the life of his fiancé, to whom he had promised marriage. Overcome by grief and a sense of loss, Si-Yun faints at the funeral home. Through his alcohol-blurred vision, a handsome face resembling his deceased fiancé keeps flashing before him. Instinctively reaching out to touch that face in search of her longed-for warmth, he finally comes to his senses.

“Why are you here...”

However, the person who appeared before Si-Yun was not his deceased fiancé, but her younger brother, U-Ju, who bore a striking resemblance to her. Under the pretext of comforting him in his grief, U-Ju wormed his way into Si-Yun’s life, and from that night on, he began to completely upend Si-Yun’s daily routine. Cleverly exploiting Si-Yun’s guilt and longing for his late fiancé, U-Ju, with his angelic face, proposes the most cruel and relentless form of subjugation…. 

A precarious romance between two men who cross the taboo of being the brother of a deceased fiancé and are swept into a twisted vortex of lust.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
